item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00194","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C02","C20","C21"],"selected_candidate_label":"C02","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C02 supplies an almost verbatim template for the child's first operative section: the same exception for quoted selection-board language, the same section 5762(a) authority, the same Navy corps, the same suspension mechanism, and the identical emergency-linked termination formula. The child materially adapts that machinery by changing the affected promotion grade from commander to captain and adding a parallel section for section 5762(b). C20 and C21 concern closely related promotion suspensions, but neither matches the child's language and structure as comprehensively.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Except as to the provision which reads ... The Secretary of the Navy shall furnish the appropriate selection board ... the provisions of section 5762 (a) of title 10 of the United States Code ... are hereby suspended","parent_excerpt":"Except as to the provision which ... reads, The Secretary of the Navy shall furnish the appropriate selection board ... the provisions of section 5762 (a) of title 10 of the United States Code ... are hereby suspended","explanation":"The child reproduces C02's distinctive exception-plus-quotation construction and its operative suspension sentence for the same statutory subsection."},{"child_excerpt":"to the extent that such provisions are applicable to promotions to the grade of captain In the Supply Corps, the Chaplain Corps, the Civil Engineer Corps, and the Medical Service Corps","parent_excerpt":"to the extent that such provisions are applicable to promotions to the grade of commander in the Supply Corps, the Chaplain Corps, the Civil Engineer Corps, and the Medical Service Corps","explanation":"The same list of corps and limiting clause is retained, with the promotion grade adapted from commander to captain."},{"child_excerpt":"until June 30 of the fiscal year following that in which the national emergency proclaimed by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of December 16, 1950 ... shall end","parent_excerpt":"until June 30 of the fiscal year following that in which the national emergency proclaimed by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of December 16, 1950, shall end","explanation":"The child carries forward C02's specific emergency-linked duration formula essentially verbatim."}]}
